name: Force Humming's SM8x JIT W4A16 backend for every GPTQ projection
hypothesis: Humming's SM8x-specific generated schedule may reduce the 96 small-M decode projection costs that dominate stock Marlin on RTX 4060.
expected_global_effect: Replace all eligible decode Marlin projections with a distinct SM8x JIT kernel while preserving frozen GPTQ tensors, BF16 activations, model topology, and request semantics.

preserved_dependencies: each projection consumes the same BF16 activation after all preceding layer dependencies
each projection produces the same logical output shape before its unchanged consumer
all attention, recurrent state, KV state, sampling, and request scheduling remain in stock vLLM
changed_boundaries: GPTQ weights are losslessly transformed into Humming's internal packed representation at load time
Marlin implementation and CTA schedule are replaced by Humming's SM8x JIT-generated W4A16 kernel
prohibited_rewrites: no modification of GPTQ integer values, zero points, or scales
no output shortlist, speculative decoding, changed sampling, or skipped work
dependency_contract.numerical_ordering: The alternative kernel may change floating-point accumulation order, so promotion requires exact greedy token identity on every frozen case and later full contract qualification.

evidence.claim: Checkpoint-derived fused shapes sum to exactly the 96 observed Marlin projection calls per decode.
